label: Specification for: VALIDATION_YEAR_INRANGE
description: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:year is bdqval:Empty or cannot be interpreted as an integer; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:year is within the range bdqval:earliestValidDate to bdqval:latestValidDate inclusive; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT bdqval:earliestValidDate default = "1582",bdqval:latestValidDate default = "{current year}"
expectedResponse: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:year is bdqval:Empty or cannot be interpreted as an integer; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:year is within the range bdqval:earliestValidDate to bdqval:latestValidDate inclusive; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
example1: dwc:year="1952": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:year is in RANGE"
example2: dwc:year="9999": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:year is not in RANGE. The value in year has not yet come to pass."
